bin_path.description: Absolute path to the gatekeeper executable binary.

listen_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to for incoming connections. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

control_port.description: TCP port for gatekeeper control communication.

data_port.description: TCP port for gatekeeper data communication (set to 0 for ephemeral port; set explicitly for firewall compatibility).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent active connections allowed.

listen_backlog.description: Maximum size of the pending connection queue.

idle_timeout.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before a connection is closed.

use_tls.description: Whether to require SSL/TLS encryption for control connections.

cert_file.description: Path to the host certificate (PEM-encoded) used for TLS.

key_file.description: Path to the host private key (PEM-encoded, unencrypted) used for TLS.

ca_cert_file.description: Path to the CA certificate bundle for verifying client certificates.

require_client_cert.description: Whether to require client certificates for authentication.

allowed_client_dns.description: List of allowed client certificate subject DNs. If empty, all certificates signed by the trusted CA are accepted.

allowed_proxy_issuers.description: List of allowed proxy issuer DNs. If empty, no restrictions are applied on proxy issuers.

allow_proxy_delegation.description: Whether to allow delegation of proxy credentials to clients.

cred_dir.description: Directory for storing delegated credentials and proxy files.

max_proxy_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime (in seconds) for delegated proxy credentials (e.g., 86400 = 1 day).

log_to_syslog.description: Whether to send log messages to the system log (syslog).

log_file.description: Path to a local log file. If empty, no file logging is performed.

log_level.description: Log verbosity level. One of: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

enabled.description: Whether the gatekeeper service should be started automatically.
